newsitem.title: USA: Enserch Cooper well finds natgas pay.
newsitem.headline: Enserch Cooper well finds natgas pay.

text.p: Enserch Exploration Inc said Thursday the SB-3 exploratory well at the Cooper project in the Garden Banks area of the Gulf of Mexico was drilled to a depth of 19,000 feet and logged 40 to 50 feet of natural-gas pay.
It said evaluation of the well, located in Garden Banks Block 387, continues. Completion operations are expected to take 30 to 45 days.
Due to rig availability, Enserch Exploration proposed and spudded the SB-3 well prior to receiving Mobil Corp's approval of the well proposal.
Mobil subsequently elected to participate in the well following its full evaluation of the well proposal but prior to Enserch Exploration's drilling out of intermediate casing.

The well is the third drilled from the three-slot subsea template located three miles away from the floating production facility located on Block 388. Upon completion, production will commence immediately, as subsea tie-backs are in place to transport hydrocarbons to the facility, Enserch said.

Based on the results of this well, the Cooper project partnership is evaluating the potential for additional opportunities in adjoining but separate fault blocks to the reservoir penetrated by the SB-3, and is working to assess the total size of the prospect.
Wednesday, Enserch said its third quarter crude oil production increased 33 percent, reflecting the contribution of the Cooper project, which began production in late September of 1995.

The company said its natural gas production for the period was 25.6 billion cubic feet down from 29.1 billion for the like period a year ago as a consequence of the sale of its Rocky Mountain properties.-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.
